answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 70 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the yarrow challenge, the vault audit can replay the saffron history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2695 identities would post 4272 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
